CREATE TABLE t2(a, b);
EXPLAIN SELECT count(*) FROM t2
SELECT count(DISTINCT *) FROM t2
EXPLAIN SELECT count(DISTINCT a) FROM t2
EXPLAIN SELECT count(a) FROM t2
EXPLAIN SELECT count() FROM t2
SELECT count(DISTINCT) FROM t2
steps.expect: 1 {DISTINCT aggregates must have exactly one argument}

steps.sql: EXPLAIN SELECT count(*)+1 FROM t2
EXPLAIN SELECT count(*) FROM t2 WHERE a IS NOT NULL
SELECT count(*) FROM t2 HAVING count(*)>1;
SELECT count(*) FROM t2 HAVING count(*)<10;
EXPLAIN SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT 1)
CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT 1 AS a
EXPLAIN SELECT count(*) FROM v1
EXPLAIN SELECT count(*), max(a) FROM t2
EXPLAIN SELECT count(*) FROM t1, t2
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE techo USING echo(t1);
EXPLAIN SELECT count(*) FROM techo

CREATE TABLE t3(a, b);
    SELECT a FROM (SELECT count(*) AS a FROM t3) WHERE a==0;
SELECT a FROM (SELECT count(*) AS a FROM t3) WHERE a==1;

CREATE INDEX t4i2 ON t4(b);
    SELECT count(*) FROM t4;

CREATE TABLE t6(x);
  SELECT count(DISTINCT) FROM t6 GROUP BY x;
